visualCharacteristics: A list of full-width bordered link buttons with arrow icons, optionally under a heading with an icon. Variants show a grey band with a white two-column list, grouped buttons under sub-headings, chevron category boxes, or outline buttons in a two-column grid.
contentPattern: Optional head row: [icon picture?] [h2/h3 heading]. One row per button: [link paragraph] [sub-text paragraph?]. For grouped layouts, one row per group: [h3/h4 group title] [link paragraphs]. In the outline variant, emphasised links become outline buttons and a plain link becomes a right-aligned text link; in the category variant each link becomes a chevron box.
usage: Use it for a set of navigation links shown as arrow buttons, such as contractor procedures or product category links.
reuseGuidance: Reuse it for any button-styled link list; pick cards or product-cards when each link needs an image and description.
